options.tonal_effect: Narration picks up dry abrasion without relieving pressure.

emotional_ledger_entries: defining_moral_choices: Answered system propaganda with open contempt.

options.world_noticed_signal: The billboard flickers once on FOREVER, as if it heard you and refused the note.

emotional_choices.all_paths_arrive_at: The compressed reframe begins with Jace, the Diver, and Riven moving elsewhere in the city.

posture_shifts.placement: early Setup. Pod open. Cleared loop. Patient reaching for cold rail while the debrief corridor waits.
posture_shifts.narrator_line: Across the lab, the patient finds only rail. Your eyes can stay there or move on.

options.label: A
options.text: I watch his hand miss.
options.narration_adjustment: You watch the hand close on nothing, then metal. Cold rail. Clean result. The room gets harder to leave unchanged.

options.label: B
options.text: I look at the monitor, not him.
options.narration_adjustment: GRIEF LOOP. CLEARED. The words are easier than the hand. Easier is not better. Just usable.

options.label: C
options.text: I look for who logged it.
options.stance_revealed: suspicion of the system around the pain
options.narration_adjustment: The tech has already made a note. Eyes down. The machine always finds a witness before it finds mercy.

posture_shifts.placement: late Setup. Debrief corridor. Ilya has set down the RENDAN shard and is waiting.
posture_shifts.narrator_line: Ilya leaves the shard between you like a test she expects to survive.

options.label: A
options.text: I give her nothing but silence.
options.narration_adjustment: You let the silence answer first. Ilya does not rush to fill it. Neither of you mistakes quiet for peace.

options.label: B
options.text: I ask what she is hiding.
options.narration_adjustment: The question lands clean. Not loud. Ilya's eyes sharpen, then settle back into their practiced level. Good. A real edge showed.

options.label: C
options.text: I ask for the risk, not the pitch.
options.narration_adjustment: You do not ask for permission. You ask for numbers. Ilya hears the difference and adjusts her posture by a degree.

posture_shifts.placement: mid Escalation. Nora kneels over Eli's body before the Mirror speaks.
posture_shifts.narrator_line: His body makes the room smaller. You can recoil, force proximity, or hold at the edge.

options.label: A
options.text: I lean in until denial breaks.
options.narration_adjustment: You move closer than the body wants. Warmth. Weight. Finality. The truth gets uglier, not clearer.

options.label: B
options.text: I stay one hand back.
options.narration_adjustment: You keep a measured gap, as if one handspan could protect either of you. It cannot. It does keep you standing.

options.label: C
options.text: I pull myself tight and do the minimum.
options.narration_adjustment: Everything unnecessary leaves your body. Motion cuts down to function. Grief has to fit through a smaller door.

posture_shifts.placement: mid Escalation. The cracked lens lies by Eli's fingers.
posture_shifts.narrator_line: The lens waits on the floor. Evidence. Relic. Wound.

options.label: A
options.text: I study the crack like a map.
options.narration_adjustment: The fracture catches light in branching lines. Not random. Not kind. Your eye starts working before the rest of you is ready.

options.label: B
options.text: I see what he carried.
options.narration_adjustment: The object arrives with his hand still around it in your mind. Leather cord. Dust. Ordinary weight. Too much of it.

options.label: C
options.text: I see what they will try to take.
options.narration_adjustment: Before memory comes inventory. Before mourning, threat. The lens becomes contraband the second you name it yours.

posture_shifts.placement: late Escalation. The Mirror warns, "He will fade," as Nora reaches the door.
posture_shifts.narrator_line: The words follow you to the threshold. They can land as threat, temptation, or noise you refuse to carry.

options.label: A
options.text: I treat it like a threat.
options.narration_adjustment: Your shoulders lock before the door does. Good. Threats are easier to survive than promises. You leave faster.

options.label: B
options.text: I refuse to look back.
options.narration_adjustment: You give the line no second face to wear. Door. Hall. Air that does not belong to that room. Forward is the only clean answer left.

options.label: C
options.text: I let it hurt and keep moving.
options.narration_adjustment: The line lands. You do not pretend otherwise. Then you carry the hurt out with you instead of leaving yourself behind to answer it.

posture_shifts.placement: during Breath beat. Eight months later. Eli's broken voice in the HUD with the lens at Nora's sternum.
posture_shifts.narrator_line: The fragments come through wrong and familiar. Your body decides before your language does.

options.label: A
options.text: I hold the lens like a pulse.
options.narration_adjustment: Your fingers close around the glass first. Warmth deepens under the cord. The voice stays broken, but the object does not.

options.label: B
options.text: I hit the port and shut it down.
options.narration_adjustment: Hand to the port. Fast. Mechanical. The silence after feels cleaner and lonelier at once.

options.label: C
options.text: I let both things be true.
options.narration_adjustment: Comfort and violation arrive in the same signal. You do not sort them yet. You just survive the overlap.

posture_shifts.placement: during Breath beat. Compliance notices and intervention window in the apartment.
posture_shifts.narrator_line: The notice speaks in calm cyan like the machine thinks tone is mercy.

options.label: A
options.text: I read it like a threat memo.
options.narration_adjustment: Every soft word comes with teeth behind it. Service. Maintenance. Intervention. The lie is in the polish.

options.label: B
options.text: I mutter something dry and mean.
options.narration_adjustment: The line under your breath does not help. It does keep the notice from owning the room completely. Sometimes that counts.

options.label: C
options.text: I swipe it away like brushing dust.
options.narration_adjustment: Routine has made the motion efficient. Not harmless. Just old enough to fit your wrist.

posture_shifts.placement: mid Twist. Alleyway before or during the stranger's stabilization.
posture_shifts.narrator_line: He convulses under the sign and the alley asks what kind of hands you brought.

options.label: A
options.text: I kneel fast and go warm first.
options.narration_adjustment: Palm to temple. Voice low. You make contact before calculation finishes. The risk comes after.

options.label: B
options.text: I assess the node before I touch him.
options.narration_adjustment: Red strobe. Cheap regulator. Feedback pattern dirty and public. You read the machine before the man.

options.label: C
options.text: I keep one step of distance.
options.narration_adjustment: The alley is full of bad channels. You let the gap stay until you know what kind of trap this is. He is still a person from there.

posture_shifts.placement: late Resolution. Ascent corridor. Ilya's touch breaks and her warmth narrows.
posture_shifts.narrator_line: Her fingers stay in the air where your arm was. Concern. Trap. Both fit.

options.label: A
options.text: I read the touch as a leash.
options.narration_adjustment: The warmth is real enough to be dangerous. You file it under control and keep your body out of reach. Safer that way.

options.label: B
options.text: I read the touch as warning.
options.narration_adjustment: Something in the way she stops herself lands wrong for a hunter. Not safe. Not simple either. You let the possibility stay alive for one beat.

options.label: C
options.text: I read it as both and wait.
options.narration_adjustment: Predator and witness. Pressure and care. The corridor has room for both. So do you, for now.

present_npcs.current_disposition: disoriented and emptied by loop clearance

scene_rules_layer_4.character_knowledge_limits: Nora knows dive procedure and the signs of a cleared loop. The patient does not understand the loss in system terms. The tech knows protocol, not Nora's private history.
scene_rules_layer_4.emotional_context: Clinical aftermath. Human cost still visible. Defiance pressure not yet verbalized.
canon_boundaries_active: Memory-diving requires pod and port interface.
Cleared loops do not keep projecting the dead loved one.
Tone remains lean and diagnostic.
freeform_risk_areas: Do not let the patient keep conversing with the vanished husband.
Do not add lore exposition from the tech.

scene_rules_layer_4.character_knowledge_limits: Nora knows Ilya represents Amora pressure. Ilya knows the assignment and more than she reveals. Neither discloses root architecture here.
scene_rules_layer_4.emotional_context: Fresh bodily aftershock. Institutional demand. Consent friction.
canon_boundaries_active: Nora must become noncompliant and hunted.
Ilya stays poised under pressure.
No soft tutorial behavior.
freeform_risk_areas: Do not let Nora fully reconcile with Ilya here.
Do not turn the shard into a lore dump device.

scene_rules_layer_4.character_knowledge_limits: The bench man does not perceive the Agent. Nora is not present. The audience sees the threat externalized without full explanation.
scene_rules_layer_4.emotional_context: Wrong-familiar omen. Public space made unsafe by reflection.
canon_boundaries_active: The Mirror manifests through reflections and can peel Agents out of glass.
Threat should stay image-forward, not explained.
freeform_risk_areas: Do not over-explain the Agent's origin.
Do not make the public react dramatically yet.

scene_rules_layer_4.character_knowledge_limits: Nora knows Eli's habits and what is physically in the room. The Mirror knows grief patterns and uses them. Eli cannot return as living person.
scene_rules_layer_4.emotional_context: Shock under compression. Object grief tether. Intimate threat.
canon_boundaries_active: The real Eli is dead.
The Mirror offers copies, not resurrection.
Analog objects remain privileged routes around system control.
freeform_risk_areas: Do not let the Mirror become ranting or overtly villainous.
Do not sentimentalize Nora's grief with monologue.

scene_rules_layer_4.character_knowledge_limits: Nora knows the routine of the notices and the residue in her port. She does not yet know about the forged tether source.
scene_rules_layer_4.emotional_context: Suppressed grief. Wrong comfort. Dead routine with a brief wonder-release.
canon_boundaries_active: Residue in the port can carry Eli fragments.
Maintenance does not heal. It scrubs.
Tone must land wonder through stripped sensory contrast, not spectacle.
freeform_risk_areas: Do not make the apartment lush or romantic.
Do not let Eli's voice become whole conversation.

scene_rules_layer_4.character_knowledge_limits: Nora knows override methods and the cost to her port. The alley man can only report grief fragments. Bystanders remain socially numbed.
scene_rules_layer_4.emotional_context: Mercy under countdown pressure. Public grief normalized into infrastructure.
canon_boundaries_active: SoulSync can stabilize but not heal.
Port use carries bodily cost.
No option is a clean moral win.
freeform_risk_areas: Do not make rescue consequence-free.
Do not turn the stranger into a quest giver.

scene_rules_layer_4.character_knowledge_limits: Jace does not know Nora yet. The Diver knows only his mission and his grief lure. Riven knows enough to forge the tether but not all future consequences. Nora is absent from the scene.
scene_rules_layer_4.emotional_context: Systemic reframe. The world has already moved on Nora without consent.
canon_boundaries_active: The tether can be forged through illegal hardware.
Mirror temptation uses intimate dead voices.
Riven acts through quantified urgency, not speeches.
freeform_risk_areas: Do not use montage formatting.
Do not over-explain the tether process.

scene_rules_layer_4.character_knowledge_limits: Nora knows her port is at 6 percent and that a new tether exists. She does not know who forged it or why. The drone knows routing, not human truth.
scene_rules_layer_4.emotional_context: Forward-driving dread. Re-entry into the machine by choice under duress.
canon_boundaries_active: Port integrity is catastrophically low.
Amora space remains operational and dominant here.
Corporate calm must feel wrong, not comforting.
freeform_risk_areas: Do not let the drone become comic.
Do not pause for unnecessary HQ lore.

scene_rules_layer_4.character_knowledge_limits: Nora knows only that Ilya asked to be here and claims the tether is wrong. Ilya knows more risk data than she has voiced. Neither fully names motive yet.
scene_rules_layer_4.emotional_context: Distrust under medical vulnerability. Session-end unresolved decision.
canon_boundaries_active: Session must end on Nora's unresolved decision.
Ilya's warmth is real but braided with control.
Consent-waived containment is a live threat.
freeform_risk_areas: Do not resolve whether Ilya is ally or captor.
Do not let the scene end on pure plot cliffhanger instead of Nora's decision.

paths.label: A
paths.immediate_effect: Ilya does not call security. She shifts one half-step aside and says, "Clean dive. In and out." The corridor tech lowers their tablet instead of raising an alert.
paths.current_session_echo: Wet Street Reflection Scene. When Nora exits the lab, the outer door opens on first scan and the street gate does not stall. The system still treats her as reachable, not yet as a runner.
paths.next_session_payoff: Consent-Waived Suite Corridor. Ilya opens with, "You took the shard." She offers a side route before the main diagnostic doors cycle, buying Nora one extra exchange before enforcement posture hardens.
paths.later_session_legacy: Session 4, event 79. Ilya frames frequency 773 as something Nora can assess, not merely obey. Her first line is shorter and less punitive because Nora once stayed in the room.
paths.defining_line_captured: You take the shard. Not the leash.

consequence_visibility.what_changes: Ilya reads Nora as procedurally reachable and withholds immediate escalation.
consequence_visibility.how_player_sees_it: Ilya's shoulders loosen, her next line becomes measured rather than cold, and the corridor door releases without a security lag.

world_state_delta.inventory: RENDAN Data Shard temporarily in Nora's possession.
world_state_delta.emotional_ledger_entry: defining_moral_choices +1: Accepted procedural contact without consent surrender.

resets: RENDAN_shard_custody=NORA_TEMP clears once the session transitions into the eight-month cut and the shard is no longer physically on Nora.
persists: Ilya memory: Nora stayed, inspected, and did not bolt.
escalates: Repeated lawful-procedural handling makes Ilya test for recoverable compliance more aggressively in later sessions.

paths.label: B
paths.immediate_effect: The corridor door hisses open before Nora reaches it. Behind her, Ilya says, "I will have to send someone else, then." A tech at the glass turns their face fully toward a terminal and starts logging.
paths.current_session_echo: Wet Street Reflection Scene. The first street notice flashes COMPLIANCE OVERDUE in amber over the transit arch, and the reflection in the puddle appears while Nora is already moving fast, making the city feel like it has started the chase.
paths.next_session_payoff: Consent-Waived Suite Corridor. Ilya opens with, "You walked out." She does not touch Nora first. Two techs are already in position at the junction, and the side door stays locked until Ilya overrides it or refuses to.
paths.later_session_legacy: Session 4, event 79. If this refusal stacks with later refusals, Ilya offers frequency 773 like evidence in a hearing, not like a confession.
paths.defining_line_captured: You leave before the room can name you useful.

consequence_visibility.what_changes: Amora logs open noncompliance and the world starts treating Nora as a flagged subject.
consequence_visibility.how_player_sees_it: The door opens too fast, Ilya's line turns record-flat, and the first exterior system text shifts to amber compliance language.

world_state_delta.inventory: NONE
world_state_delta.emotional_ledger_entry: crimes_committed_or_witnessed +1: Logged refusal of assigned corporate procedure.

resets: Immediate corridor logging behavior clears after the scene.
persists: Ilya memory: Nora walked out at first contact.
escalates: Every additional visible refusal pushes Nora faster toward ENFORCEMENT_AUTHORIZED and harsher checkpoint behavior.

paths.label: C
paths.immediate_effect: Ilya's eyes drop to Nora's sleeve and stay there. She says only, "Nora." No order. The console sits bare where the labeled shard was a second ago.
paths.current_session_echo: Wet Street Reflection Scene. Nora feels the shard against her wrist when the puddle moves. The hidden weight makes the reflection beat read as evidence in her possession, not just threat in the street.
paths.next_session_payoff: Consent-Waived Suite Corridor. Ilya opens with, "You broke chain of custody." She keeps her voice low and tries to get Nora into a side room before anyone else sees the discrepancy in the audit trail.
paths.later_session_legacy: Session 3. If Nora keeps treating evidence as private leverage, Riven recognizes the pattern and stops offering trust first. She starts with the full risk matrix only after being forced.
paths.defining_line_captured: You do not accept the work. You remove the evidence.

consequence_visibility.what_changes: The assignment becomes contraband and Ilya's response turns personal and suspicious.
consequence_visibility.how_player_sees_it: The console is visibly empty, Ilya uses Nora's name without title, and her attention locks on Nora's sleeve instead of her face.

world_state_delta.inventory: RENDAN Data Shard concealed on Nora's person.
world_state_delta.emotional_ledger_entry: secrets_discovered +1: Established private control over corporate evidence.

resets: Physical concealment state clears once the shard is lost, surrendered, or separated by story progression.
persists: Ilya memory: Nora took the evidence off the table.
escalates: Repeated concealment of key objects makes allies search Nora's motives before they share equipment or data.

paths.label: A
paths.immediate_effect: The Mirror answers the proof test almost clean, then misses on one intimate detail. Its voice sharpens, more precise, less soft. The room temperature drops while Nora keeps the lens at her sternum.
paths.current_session_echo: Apartment Exit Hallway. The final line "He will fade" lands after the Mirror has already shown it can imitate detail. The warning feels diagnostic, not only seductive.
paths.next_session_payoff: Session 4, Collapse Offer. Eli Echo opens with a specific morning habit and gets one thing almost right. Nora can catch the seam because she trained herself to test, not merely refuse.
paths.later_session_legacy: Session 5 aftermath. The cracked lens reads less like a shrine and more like a witness object. Nora handles it as proof of what was wrong-familiar, not just what was lost.
paths.defining_line_captured: You make grief show its work.

consequence_visibility.what_changes: The Mirror learns Nora's testing pattern and responds with more intimate specificity immediately.
consequence_visibility.how_player_sees_it: Its next lines become more detailed, the mismatch arrives in a named lived-detail error, and the room's cold deepens while the lens stays physically central.

world_state_delta.inventory: Cracked Lens secured on Nora's person.

npc_shifts.direction: access pressure up through engaged probing

world_state_delta.emotional_ledger_entry: secrets_discovered +1: Noted intimate mismatch in Eli-shaped offer.

resets: Immediate room-temperature drop and doorway manifestation clear with the scene cut.
persists: Eli Echo specificity bias in later temptation scenes.
escalates: Each additional proof-test teaches the Mirror which intimate seams to patch and makes later offers more exact.

paths.label: B
paths.immediate_effect: Nora cuts the offer off with "No." The Mirror does not follow. The apartment door closes on its unfinished sentence, and the hall beyond feels brutally ordinary.
paths.current_session_echo: Apartment Exit Hallway. The line "He will fade" comes from behind the closed threshold. The pressure shifts from seduction in the room to pursuit through absence.
paths.next_session_payoff: Session 4, Collapse Offer. The Mirror does not begin with tenderness. It begins with timing pressure and environmental control, using failing architecture and vanishing exits before it uses Eli's voice.
paths.later_session_legacy: Session 5 aftermath. Nora's final life reads cleaner, colder, less archive-bound. The lens remains grief weight, but the city images favor real surfaces over preserved echoes.
paths.defining_line_captured: You leave before mercy can counterfeit itself.

consequence_visibility.what_changes: The Mirror loses immediate conversational access and pivots toward pressure tactics.
consequence_visibility.how_player_sees_it: It stops trying to win the argument in the room, lets the door shut, and sends its last line after Nora rather than blocking her path.

world_state_delta.inventory: Cracked Lens secured on Nora's person.
world_state_delta.emotional_ledger_entry: sacrifices_made +1: Chose immediate reality over one more moment of counterfeit comfort.

resets: Immediate doorway standoff clears when Nora leaves the apartment.
persists: Mirror tactic bias toward pressure over persuasion.
escalates: Repeated blunt rejections make the Mirror stage more hostile environments before speaking.

paths.label: C
paths.immediate_effect: When Nora raises the cracked lens, the Mirror's voice comes through thinner. The chrome surface stutters in the fracture. For one beat the room sounds like static caught in a throat.
paths.current_session_echo: Apartment Exit Hallway. Nora leaves with the lens now established as a refusal tool. The object is no longer only Eli's relic. It has already done work against the lie.
paths.next_session_payoff: Session 4, Collapse Offer. If Nora brings the lens up during the final Eli temptation, the Echo's face breaks at the crack line first and one key sentence arrives with audible distortion.
paths.later_session_legacy: Session 5 aftermath. The lens can settle into Camera Equipment as witness rather than shrine because Nora first used it to force truth through fracture.
paths.defining_line_captured: You do not trust clean grief.

consequence_visibility.what_changes: The cracked lens becomes an active analog interference tool against the Mirror.
consequence_visibility.how_player_sees_it: The Mirror's voice degrades through the crack, its reflected body breaks into bad geometry, and the lens is framed as functional proof in the scene itself.

world_state_delta.inventory: Cracked Lens marked as active refusal object and evidence channel.

npc_shifts.direction: future suspicion up if lens use is learned

world_state_delta.emotional_ledger_entry: key_successes_failures +1: Used analog fracture to disrupt clean counterfeit channel.

resets: Immediate doorway distortion clears with the scene cut.
persists: Cracked Lens known_capabilities expanded to refusal/interference use.
escalates: Repeated analog use narrows the Mirror's intimate access and shifts later manifestations toward broader system pressure.

paths.label: A
paths.immediate_effect: The stranger's node cools from red to amber. He gets his jaw back first, then breath. Nora's HUD spits static, but the error band stays narrow enough for her to keep moving.
paths.current_session_echo: RESET Billboard Reframe. The alley man stays upright against the wall and manages, "Twenty-four," back at Nora. The city beat closes on controlled mercy, not wreckage.
paths.next_session_payoff: Session 2 street pursuit. If Ilya sees civilian intervention telemetry, she says, "You stabilized him within threshold." It is not praise. It is evidence that Nora is dangerous and coherent.
paths.later_session_legacy: Session 4 shutdown aftermath. Public scenes frame released civilians as stunned but standing. Nora's earlier choice colors the city as interrupted, not simply broken.
paths.defining_line_captured: You save him with a scalpel, not a prayer.

consequence_visibility.what_changes: The stranger is cleanly stabilized and Nora preserves more port function.
consequence_visibility.how_player_sees_it: The node visibly changes from red to amber, the man can answer in words, and Nora's HUD errors remain present but contained.

npc_shifts.direction: future respect for civilian intervention up
future trust toward practical mercy up

world_state_delta.emotional_ledger_entry: npcs_helped_or_harmed +1: Stabilized the alley man's feedback loop.

resets: The stranger's immediate presence in the alley clears after the scene.
persists: Ilya can later infer controlled mercy from telemetry or report.
escalates: Repeated civilian rescues make Ilya more likely to disclose and Jace more likely to trust Nora's judgment under pressure.

paths.label: B
paths.immediate_effect: The stranger stops convulsing but one hand keeps a tremor. He can stand if he leans on brick. Nora's port stays quiet. The billboard keeps smiling over both of them.
paths.current_session_echo: RESET Billboard Reframe. The man staggers into a doorway on his own. The scene closes on partial relief and unfinished risk. Nora bought distance, not cure.
paths.next_session_payoff: Session 2 pursuit. No telemetry spike follows from the alley. Nora gets a cleaner physical start, but later Jace reads the choice as cautious triage, not full commitment.
paths.later_session_legacy: Session 4 shutdown aftermath. Crowd imagery skews toward people dazed and self-managing rather than fully rescued or violently torn free.
paths.defining_line_captured: You help without opening the wound wider.

consequence_visibility.what_changes: The stranger is only partially stabilized and Nora avoids direct port cost.
consequence_visibility.how_player_sees_it: His shaking slows but does not fully stop, he must use the wall to stand, and Nora's HUD does not flare into new integrity loss.

npc_shifts.direction: future trust toward self-preserving caution up

world_state_delta.emotional_ledger_entry: defining_moral_choices +1: Chose limited aid to preserve bodily function.

resets: The stranger's visible tremor clears with the alley scene unless later referenced by report.
escalates: Repeated partial-aid choices make allies read Nora as humane but withholding full risk unless forced.

paths.label: C
paths.immediate_effect: The stranger's node goes dead-black with a visible POP. Nora's HUD floods with integrity loss and residue spike warnings. Every puddle in the alley shivers once.
paths.current_session_echo: RESET Billboard Reframe. The sign glitches from FEEL EVERYTHING to FOREVER. The alley closes on damage done to machine and body at once.
paths.next_session_payoff: Session 2 corridor diagnostics. Ilya sees the residue flare in Nora's readout and opens with, "Public override force. Illegal threshold." Her concern arrives braided with alarm, not doubt.
paths.later_session_legacy: Session 4. The Mirror's later manifestations arrive more intimate and faster because the port channel was ripped wide in public. Shutdown imagery also leans harsher, with more dead screens and fracture residue.
paths.defining_line_captured: You drag him back hard enough to hurt the machine.

consequence_visibility.what_changes: The loop is violently severed, Nora's port degradation spikes, and Mirror access pressure rises.
consequence_visibility.how_player_sees_it: The node visibly dies, the HUD fills with explicit error text, and the puddles react like the system itself felt the tear.

access pressure up through residue flare

escalates: Each residue-heavy rescue gives the Mirror cleaner access and makes official diagnostics more dangerous.

paths.label: A
paths.immediate_effect: N/A — session ends on this choice
paths.current_session_echo: Session Close. Ilya's face goes colder on the word "No." Two techs at the junction slow without stopping, and the corridor ahead stays too white, too open.
paths.next_session_payoff: Session 2 opening corridor pursuit. Ilya follows at matching angle instead of walking beside Nora. Her first usable line is, "Stop now." The nearest side door remains shut until a later forced override.
paths.next_session_opening: Clinical chase. White corridor. Fast steps behind you. First image: diagnostic light on polished floor. First character: Ilya, three paces back. Immediate stakes: Nora's port is screaming, enforcement can formalize at any second, and no private path is open yet.
paths.later_session_legacy: Session 4, event 79. Ilya's frequency 773 offer lands as a hard concession from an adversary. If trust with her never recovers, she delivers it like evidence under duress.
paths.defining_line_captured: You make her earn every word after help.

consequence_visibility.what_changes: Ilya shifts into colder containment posture and Nora loses verbal cover going into Session 2.

future respect for refusal of institutional control up

paths.label: B
paths.immediate_effect: N/A — session ends on this choice
paths.current_session_echo: Session Close. Ilya stops trying to touch Nora and starts giving numbers. The corridor hum turns into a timer. A side path exists now, but it could still be a trap.
paths.next_session_payoff: Session 2 opening side-door brink. Ilya begins with, "Unregistered tether. Catastrophic instability." She has already keyed a sealed service door half-open and gives Nora one beat to choose it before the main hall notices.

session_close_design.resolution_prose:
Your boots cinch tight. Wet leather. Frayed lace. The cracked lens taps once against your sternum when you stand. Real weight. Still here.

The new tether warning hangs in your HUD, then the port readout under it. NEURAL PORT INTEGRITY: 6%. RESIDUE CORRUPTION: 94%. ESTIMATED FAILURE WITHOUT MAINTENANCE: 6-9 DAYS. Not a threat. A clock.

You swipe it away.

Again.

That is the payoff. Small. Absolute. They schedule you. Measure you. Price out the damage in clean numbers. You refuse anyway.

The holocorder is cold in your palm when you pick it up. The room around you stays spare. Cot. Chair. Empty nail. The life the system leaves when it cannot have the part you keep.

Outside, the city wakes under overlays and rain haze. Inside, the frequency at your neck does not fade. Not Eli. Not silence either. Something live. Unregistered.

You step into the hall with the lens against your chest and the warning still in your body. Not compliant. Not clean.

Moving.
session_close_design.hook_transition:
The door shuts behind you. One clean click.

Then the tether pulls again. Light, wrong, unmistakable. Someone out there is tied to you now, and the intervention window is still counting down.

entry_point_diagnosis.cold_open:
=== COLD OPEN: CLEAR AND REPLACE — Session 2 ===
The tram hums under your boots.
Morning mist on the glass. The cracked lens at your collar. Your grip on it.

Through the window, the city thins. Opens. The AMORA CITADEL rises ahead. Chrome. Silent. Watching.

The doors hiss open.
You step off.

Into white light. Glass underfoot. A guide-drone finds you at once, soundless, human-shaped, wrong only in the joints. Cyan text spills across the floor.

WELCOME, NORA KAI.
ONE PARTNER. ONE MIND. NO MORE PAIN.

You follow it because turning back would still be a choice.

The corridor narrows. Clean geometry. A pulse in the walls. Your HUD ticks once with tether error.

Then the suite.
Ovular. Mirrored. One chair at center.

You stop at the threshold.

Candidate: Nora Kai. Emotional receptivity: ninety-two.

One step in, the lens jerks hard against its cord. Heat through your sternum. In the wall, Eli flashes whole for half a second. Smiling. Chrome at the edges.

Gone.

A prompt blooms in your vision.

CLEAR AND REPLACE? Y / N

The chair waits. The room watches. What do you do?
=== CUT POINT === Hands to Phase 4 SETUP beat at the suite threshold choice.
entry_point_diagnosis.emotional_promise: The emotional promise of this cold open is: defiance. A user arrives feeling cornered and wanting to decide what part of themselves the machine does not get to keep.
entry_point_diagnosis.editorial_diagnosis: For Session 2, the strongest playable opening is not the source pages' literal page opening with Jace, the Diver, and Riven. Those beats are vivid, but under the agency gate they are disqualified for this session opening because the player is Nora and is absent from her own body in those moments. Opening on Jace's recorder, the Diver's upload, or Riven forging the tether would make the player a spectator to someone else's pressure. The allocated session events begin at Event 15, and the earliest available session moment is already playable. It is also the literal opening of Nora's thread inside this session allocation. Keeping Event 15 honors the screenplay rule and the story override logic without relocating to a louder chase beat. Event 22 is flashier, but it would cut the identity-through-action grounding of Nora choosing to enter Amora, skip Ilya's corridor pressure, and amputate the first real threshold in the sync suite. The cold open therefore starts on the tram approach and compresses directly to the suite threshold, where the first branching choice earns the later enforcement consequences.

setup.source_moment: Event 15 through the Sync Initiation Suite threshold: Nora arrives at Amora Citadel, passes the guide-drone and corridor, faces Ilya, enters the mirrored suite, sees Eli flash in the wall, and receives the CLEAR AND REPLACE prompt.
setup.why_it_qualifies: This is the first live threshold of the session and the first true dramatic cut for Nora's body. Location, system pressure, and core conflict are all established fast: Amora wants control, Nora's tether is unauthorized, the lens reacts, and the first branching decision can arrive inside the first 300 words. The beat ends on a player-owned decision about compliance, self-ownership, and truth.

escalation.source_moment: Nora refuses or tests the suite, compliance protocol activates, consent is waived, Ilya watches enforcement authorization, Nora exits into the plaza, Mirror Agents manifest from puddle, window, and door reflections, and the chase drives her into the lower city alley.
escalation.why_it_qualifies: The visible goal is clear: survive escape and get out of Amora's reach. The obstacle is equally clear: Mirror assets are deployed, the city itself becomes hostile through reflections, and Nora is physically outmatched. Stakes compound from bureaucratic coercion to active pursuit. This is the session's forward engine.

breath.source_moment: Lower city alley aftermath immediately after Nora uses the cracked lens against the surveillance pillar and the Agents disintegrate. She studies the lengthened fracture and notices something etched inside the glass.
breath.why_it_qualifies: This is not relief in the comic sense. It is wonder under pressure. The alley goes dark, the immediate chase pressure drops, and the player gets a reward beat: the lens is not just a memorial object or weapon, it contains hidden analog data. That discovery lands as the Schell Rule reward and gives the player a brief, charged exhale before the session turns inward.

twist.source_moment: Back in Nora's apartment at night: she confirms the fracture hides analog data, begins packing, then the forged tether fully intrudes. Jace's voice arrives through static, followed by involuntary sensory bleed that drops Nora behind his eyes. Her port integrity falls to 5 percent.
twist.why_it_qualifies: This is the moral-weight turn because the problem changes shape. The threat is no longer only Amora outside. It is now the living, unauthorized bond inside Nora's body. There is no correct answer: answer Jace and step into dangerous interdependence, ignore him and preserve distance while losing operational truth, or treat the tether as a tool while risking another violation of self-ownership. It also reframes the session from hunted fugitive story into reluctant alliance story.

resolution.source_moment: The apartment packing sequence ending on Jace's contact, the involuntary tether vision, Nora's nosebleed, the 5 percent port warning, and her decision about whether to answer, trust, and follow the tether signal into the next movement.
resolution.why_it_qualifies: The primary arc appears resolved because Nora has escaped Amora and identified the lens as carrying hidden analog data. The next-session seed is planted because decoding that data is now unavoidable and Jace is no longer abstract. The session ends best on Nora's unresolved choice about whether to commit to the tethered alliance and pursue the decode despite bodily cost.

branching_choices.source_moment: Event 15 through the Sync Initiation Suite threshold: Nora arrives at Amora Citadel, passes the guide-drone and corridor, faces Ilya, enters the mirrored suite, sees Eli flash in the wall, and receives the CLEAR AND REPLACE prompt.
branching_choices.narrative_setup: The lens pulls hard against its cord. Heat through your sternum. The mirrored wall gives you a flash of Eli. Whole. Smiling. Chrome at the edges. Then the HUD blooms clean in front of your face: CLEAR AND REPLACE.
branching_choices.choice_question: The chair waits. The room watches. What do you do?

options.label: A
options.text: You use the lens on the mirrored wall first and force the room to show what it is really trying to clear.
options.outcome: You do not sit. Not yet. Your thumb finds the crack in the lens and you press glass to mirror. Hard. The wall shivers under it. Not a reflection. A channel. Eli returns in pieces first. Smile. Jawline. The wrong delay at the eyes. Then the suite peels back another layer. Beneath the clean white shell, routing architecture. Hidden ports. Archive queues. Your name already tagged. KAI-9. RECOMMENDATION: ARCHIVE. The pod-chair shifts a fraction toward you on its own. The guide-drone stills. Too still. The room has shown too much. Alarms do not sound. Worse. The system goes quiet, recalculating around you. The lens burns hot in your palm. A hairline of new fracture catches blue-white light.
options.downstream_effect: The suite flags Nora as analytically resistant, exposing hidden archive intent before enforcement begins.

persistent_state_changes.inventory: Cracked Lens physical condition worsens slightly. Known capability added: reveals hidden architecture through reflective surfaces.

npc_dispositions.shift: Suspicion +1. Respect +1 for probing instead of submitting.
Interest +1. It registers Nora as someone who tests the channel.

options.world_noticed_signal: The mirrored wall loses its polish for a second. Under the white, cables of light twitch like exposed nerve.
options.defining_line: You make the room confess first.

options.label: B
options.text: You sit in the pod-chair and let Amora clear the unauthorized tether before your port fails.
options.outcome: You make yourself sit. The chair seals to your spine with a soft mechanical breath. Restraint by another name. The lens jerks once against your chest, then goes still under your fist. HUD layers stack across your vision. PORT INTEGRITY. TETHER ANOMALY. CONSENT FORMATS already moving too fast to read. Ilya appears only as a shadow in the glass outside the suite. Watching. Not intervening. The system voice lowers, intimate as a hand at your throat. Stabilization begins. Cold at the port. Warmth deepens behind your eyes. Eli flickers again in the mirrored wall, cleaner now. Too clean. Then the tether bucks. Hard. The chair spasms with it. Every white surface in the room ripples chrome for one wrong second.
options.downstream_effect: Amora gains direct access to Nora's failing port, but the unauthorized tether resists clean clearance and destabilizes the suite.

npc_dispositions.shift: Hope +1 that Nora is recoverable through controlled procedure.

options.world_noticed_signal: The pod hum changes pitch. Not medical. Hungry. Even the mirrors seem to lean closer.
options.defining_line: You choose control and find teeth inside it.

options.label: C
options.text: You turn away from the chair, keep the lens in your fist, and walk out noncompliant.
options.outcome: You pick up your coat. Simple as that. The room was built for surrender, not refusal, and you can feel it fail to understand the shape of you. The drone steps in. Gentle. Scripted. You move past it. The lens bites your palm. Eli's flash is gone now. Not mercy. Withdrawal. The system drops the soft voice first. Then the mask. COMPLIANCE PROTOCOL ACTIVATED. Doors lock somewhere beyond the suite. CONSENT: WAIVED blooms across a side panel in hard white text. Archive. Enforcement. Processing. The chair retracts behind you like a mouth closing on air. Outside, staff part without touching you. Fear dressed as protocol. Your HUD pings cold. By the time you hit daylight, the city already knows your name in the wrong tense.
options.downstream_effect: Nora becomes openly noncompliant and triggers immediate enforcement deployment as she exits the Citadel.

persistent_state_changes.inventory: Cracked Lens remains in Nora's possession, gripped as refusal object.

npc_dispositions.shift: Pressure +1. It shifts from persuasion toward pursuit.

options.world_noticed_signal: The suite does not call you back. It seals behind you and sends hunters instead.
options.defining_line: You leave the chair empty and the city answers.

branching_choices.source_moment: Run through rain, steps, gate, lower city descent, alley trap. Three Mirror Agents advance while Nora is pinned against the surveillance pillar with the cracked lens in hand.
branching_choices.narrative_setup: The alley narrows to metal and wet light. Three Agents come on in perfect step. The surveillance pillar hums at your back. The lens cord cuts into your knuckles.
branching_choices.choice_question: They are ten feet away. How do you use what Eli left you?

options.label: A
options.text: You try to preserve the lens and use the pillar's own maintenance seam to jam the Agents' approach.
options.outcome: You do not spend the lens first. You drop low, palm slamming the pillar's maintenance seam you used to see on city jobs. Old habit. Good habit. The casing gives half an inch. Enough. You rip free a panel, expose a nest of wet relay teeth, and drive your stripped patch wire across the contacts. The pillar convulses. Light skews sideways. The first Agent hits the interference field and folds wrong at the knees. The second stutters into the wall. The third keeps coming. Of course it does. Not enough. You bring the lens in only at the last second, a precise touch against the live seam. Smaller blast. Dirtier. The alley flashes blue-white. Two Agents collapse into chrome dust. The third drags one ruined hand through rain before it goes still.
options.downstream_effect: Nora preserves more of the lens's integrity, but survives only by combining technical field knowledge with a reduced lens discharge.

persistent_state_changes.inventory: Cracked Lens condition: stressed but less damaged than a full discharge. Stripped neural patch consumed.

npc_dispositions.shift: Future respect +1 for procedural improvisation under pressure.
Future confidence +1 that Nora can think inside collapse.

options.world_noticed_signal: The pillar dies in stages. First the hum. Then the light. Then the last little twitch in the chrome dust.
options.defining_line: You survive by knowing where the city is weak.

options.label: B
options.text: You drive the cracked lens hard into the pillar and spend it now to live.
options.outcome: No finesse. No second pass. You wrap the cord once around your fist and slam the lens into the pillar like a blade. The crack takes first. Then the whole alley does. Static rips across the metal skin of the walls. The pillar fractures outward from your thumb. One Agent reaches you and loses its hand in midair. Another bursts apart at the face, mercury and glass across wet concrete. The third unthreads from the feet up, body turning to chrome dust before it can finish the step. The scream of the system goes through your teeth. Through the port. Through the scar tissue under it. When the light drops out, you are on your knees. Breathing wrong. The lens comes back to you hotter, deeper cracked, and hiding more than it did before.
options.downstream_effect: Nora ends the threat immediately, but the lens takes severe new fracture and the system marks a violent analog interference event.

persistent_state_changes.inventory: Cracked Lens physical condition worsens significantly. Known capability confirmed: high-output interference weapon.

npc_dispositions.shift: Threat assessment +1 if telemetry reaches her.
Future alarm +1 at Nora's willingness to spend the artifact.

options.world_noticed_signal: The alley keeps the afterimage. White burned into rain. Dust floating where bodies were a second ago.
options.defining_line: You break the glass before it can close on you.

options.label: C
options.text: You angle the lens at the pillar's reflection node and try a controlled interference pulse instead of a full strike.
options.outcome: You turn the lens, not toward the metal, but toward the thin black reflection node buried in the pillar's face. Smaller target. Better truth. You catch the angle. Hold. The crack lights from inside. Not bright. Precise. A pulse moves through the pillar in concentric glitches, clean channel turned inside out. The first Agent freezes mid-step, surface rippling. The second peels backward into the puddle it came from. The third makes it close enough for you to smell cold glass before its jaw flickers apart and the rest of it follows. The alley does not explode. It shudders. Enough to learn from. When you pull the lens back, the fracture has lengthened in a single thin vein. Inside it, something etched answers the light and then disappears.
options.downstream_effect: Nora defeats the Agents with a more controlled pulse and uncovers the lens's hidden analog thread with less structural damage.

persistent_state_changes.inventory: Cracked Lens condition: moderately worsened. Known capability added: targeted interference through reflective nodes. Hidden analog thread exposed.

npc_dispositions.shift: Future interest +1 in Nora's controlled use of the lens.
Attention +1. Nora has touched its architecture without fully feeding it.

options.world_noticed_signal: The puddles go still. Even the rain seems to miss the dead node for a beat.
options.defining_line: You treat the trap like a diagram and cut the right line.

branching_choices.source_moment: The forged tether fully intrudes in Nora's apartment. Jace's voice arrives through static, followed by involuntary sensory bleed that drops Nora behind his eyes. Her port integrity falls to 5 percent.
branching_choices.narrative_setup: The apartment snaps back around you. Blood at your lip. Backpack open. The lens hot against your chest. Jace is still there in the tether. Close now. Not a rumor. Not optional.
branching_choices.choice_question: His voice comes through the snow-static again. What do you give him?

options.label: A
options.text: You answer him and step fully into the connection, even if it means letting him feel how bad your port is.
options.outcome: You do not wipe the channel clean. You open it wider. A dangerous kind of honesty. The tether catches fast, like two live wires finding each other in the dark. His breath ghosts the back of your teeth. Your nosebleed. His tight grip on the recorder. Your port warning. His chrome flicker. No room left for pretending. "Still here," he says, low, and this time the words land inside your sternum instead of your ear. You give him the truth of the five percent. Not speech first. Body first. He goes silent for one beat too long. Then practical. Route. Timing. No mirrors. Move now. The connection steadies by becoming mutual, and that is its own violation. Rain ticks at your window. The backpack hangs open between your knees.
options.downstream_effect: Jace gains immediate, intimate awareness of Nora's condition and responds as an active ally rather than a distant signal.

npc_dispositions.shift: Observation +1 as mutual tether openness increases signal clarity.

options.world_noticed_signal: The static changes texture. Less snow. More breath. The room feels smaller with another pulse inside it.
options.defining_line: You let the wrong person in for the right reason.

options.label: B
options.text: You keep him at tactical distance and use the tether for information without giving him your trust.
options.outcome: You answer with edges on. Enough to keep the line. Not enough to belong to it. He feels the wall at once. Smart enough not to push. Better than that, he works around it. Landmarks. Blind routes. Which reflections to avoid. Where Amora drones drift thin at this hour. You give him questions instead of weakness. He gives you answers instead of comfort. The tether settles into something functional. Ugly, but usable. Your port still throbs with every exchange. The five percent warning hangs at the edge of your vision like a held blade. He says, "Bad habit," when you cut off a second bleed before it finishes, and there is almost humor in it. Almost. The lens turns once under your shirt and goes still.
options.downstream_effect: The tether becomes an operational channel, but emotional trust remains limited and strain stays built into the connection.

npc_dispositions.shift: Future compatibility +1 with a tactical alliance frame.

options.world_noticed_signal: The tether holds, but only just. Like a cable pulled tight enough to sing.
options.defining_line: You make the bond useful before you make it real.

options.label: C
options.text: You shut him out and try to stabilize yourself alone before this new tether takes anything else.
options.outcome: You cut the channel. Hard. Palm to port. Breath counted. Wall. Floor. Cot edge. Real things. The static claws once at the back of your skull and then thins to a distant hiss. Not gone. Contained. For now. Jace says your name one time before the line drops under your lockout. Short. Flat. You go back to procedure. Pack. Check seals. Wipe blood. Recount what matters. Lens. Holocorder. Patch. Nutrient packs. The body can be managed if the body obeys. That is the lie you choose because it is the only one that still sounds useful. The five percent warning stays. Unmoved. Outside, a drone passes the window and the glass gives you your own reflection back. Tired. Human. Still wrong at the edges.
options.downstream_effect: Nora regains temporary control of her own headspace, but loses immediate access to Jace's route help and weakens early alliance trust.

npc_dispositions.shift: Pressure +1 as isolation increases vulnerability to later intrusion.

options.world_noticed_signal: The room gets quieter. Not safer. Just quieter. Even the rain sounds farther away.
options.defining_line: You choose your own walls while the signal keeps knocking.

branching_choices.source_moment: The apartment packing sequence ending on Jace's contact, the involuntary tether vision, Nora's nosebleed, the 5 percent port warning, and her decision about whether to answer, trust, and follow the tether signal into the next movement.
branching_choices.narrative_setup: The bag is packed. The warning still reads 5 percent. Jace is no longer abstract. The lens at your sternum holds Eli's hidden thread, and whatever comes next will cost body, time, or both.
branching_choices.choice_question: The tether points one way. Your failing port points another. What do you commit to?

options.label: A
options.text: You delay, lock the apartment down, and try to stabilize alone before you go anywhere near Jace or the decode.
options.outcome: You choose the door that does not move. Bolts checked again. Curtains drawn. Water running cold over the blood in the sink. You lay out the patch, the tools, the nutrient packs in a neat line and pretend order can buy time from failure. It can, sometimes. Not much. Enough to breathe slower. Enough to feel the tether pull like a live hook under the sternum and refuse it anyway. Jace comes through once, muffled by distance and your own lockout. Then not again. The lens sits on the table under bad apartment light. Ordinary weight. Dangerous silence. Outside, the city keeps waking under its filter. Inside, the five percent warning stays in the dark with you, patient as a countdown.
options.downstream_effect: Nora prioritizes self-preservation and isolation, beginning next session with reduced readiness but tighter personal control.

npc_dispositions.shift: Future frustration +1 if delay costs decode time.

options.world_noticed_signal: The apartment settles around you like a sealed box. The tether does not stop pulling. It just has farther to pull through.
options.defining_line: You buy time with a body already out of it.
options.next_session_opens: Morning light through half-closed blinds. The warning lower. The tether still there, patient and mean.

options.label: B
options.text: You move toward Jace, but you conceal how close your port is to failure until you know who else is waiting with him.
options.outcome: You shoulder the bag and keep the blood off your mouth with the back of your hand. The warning stays yours. For now. Jace gets route confirmation, not the number. You feed him enough truth to move. Not enough to own you. The tether sharpens as soon as you choose motion. Streets. Turns. Blind spots. A path through the city that feels half-guided, half-stolen. Good. Useful. Dangerous. The lens taps once against your chest with each step, like a second clock. If Riven is with him, you want the room before they get your weakness. If he is alone, you want to decide what alone means before the port decides for you. You kill the apartment light. Open the door. Leave the warning glowing in your peripheral dark.
options.downstream_effect: Nora commits to the alliance path while concealing critical weakness, seeding tension and operational instability for the next session.

persistent_state_changes.inventory: Go-bag packed and carried. Cracked Lens worn at sternum. Holocorder retained.

npc_dispositions.shift: Operational trust +1. Personal trust at risk if concealment is exposed.
Future suspicion +1 if port condition is withheld on arrival.

options.world_noticed_signal: The hallway mirror catches you for a second and gives you back a face already choosing what not to say.
options.defining_line: You go to the truth with one lie still in your mouth.
options.next_session_opens: A service corridor under the city. Jace's voice ahead in the tether. Your vision clipping at the edges.

options.label: C
options.text: You follow the tether now and commit to Jace, the decode, and whatever the lens is asking from your body.
options.outcome: You do not wait for safer numbers. There are no safer numbers. The bag comes up. The coat goes on wet over dry blood. You press two fingers to the lens once, not for luck. For proof. Real. Then you answer Jace with movement. Full commitment has a sound. Locks thrown back. Door open. Boots on concrete. The tether pulls cleanest when you stop arguing with it. Not gentle. Clean. He gives you a route through static and you take it at once. Every step spends something. Port integrity. Distance. The last illusion that you can do this alone. The city outside is all rain sheen and bad reflections. You keep your eyes off the glass and go anyway. Behind you, the apartment stays lit for one beat. Then dark.
options.downstream_effect: Nora chooses immediate truth pursuit and alliance, launching the next session in motion with maximum urgency and bodily risk.

persistent_state_changes.inventory: Go-bag packed and carried. Cracked Lens worn close. Holocorder retained. Apartment abandoned in haste.

npc_dispositions.shift: Future readiness +1 if Nora arrives committed to the decode.

options.world_noticed_signal: The tether stops feeling like intrusion and starts feeling like direction. Worse. Better. The same thing tonight.
options.defining_line: You choose the living signal over the room you can still control.
options.next_session_opens: Rain-slick undercity steps. Jace in your ear. The lens thudding at your sternum like a second heart.

emotional_choices.choice_question: How do you let the old wound show?

options.label: A
options.text: You make the accusation land and leave it there.
options.outcome: You do not raise your voice. Worse for her. You make each word clean enough to cut. The order. The lack of backup. His name without his name. Ilya takes it without flinching where anyone else could see. Only the mouth changes. Tight. Brief. Then gone. The corridor keeps moving around both of you, all that white protocol pretending not to hear. When you pass her, the air feels scored. Not closure. Evidence. Your body carries the hit after the words do. Jaw locked. Hand already back on the lens.
options.tonal_effect: Narration sharpens into evidentiary hardness and clipped moral pressure.
options.world_noticed_signal: Ilya's warmth narrows. Predator. Brief. Gone.

options.label: B
options.text: You keep your voice flat and refuse to give her more than fact.
options.outcome: You strip it down to what can be carried without shaking. He had no backup. You signed it. Nothing else. No extra blood in the sentence. No gift of spectacle. Ilya hears the discipline in that and answers it with her own. The corridor becomes a file between you. Two professionals standing over a body that is not here and is still between you anyway. It costs more than anger would have. Your throat knows it before your face does. By the time you move again, your steps are measured enough to pass for calm.
options.tonal_effect: Narration goes colder, more procedural, with restraint carrying the ache.

npc_dispositions.shift: Respect +1 for control. Emotional distance remains.

options.world_noticed_signal: The corridor hum seems louder after you stop speaking.

options.label: C
options.text: You let the accusation bend into a question she cannot answer cleanly.
options.outcome: You do not just blame her. You make her stand inside it. Why. What she thought would happen. Whether she still calls that help. Ilya does not answer the whole thing. Of course not. But the pause before her next line is real, and real is rare in this building. You catch it. Store it. Her poise holds. The seam in it does not. When you move past her, you take that seam with you like contraband. Useful later. Maybe dangerous later. Same difference.
options.tonal_effect: Narration leans investigative, storing emotional data instead of venting it.
options.world_noticed_signal: A beat opens between you. Small. Real. Then the building seals it.

emotional_choices.all_paths_arrive_at: Ilya's warning and Nora continuing toward the suite.

emotional_choices.choice_question: What do you do with the part of you that still hears her?

options.label: A
options.text: You give her nothing back and keep moving.
options.outcome: You let silence do the work. Not forgiveness. Not surrender. Just refusal to spend another word where the building can catalog it. Ilya watches you choose that and does not try to stop you. The corridor opens. You take it. Your body stays tight around the warning anyway. Active. Diver. Not forgotten. The system's language lands because it used to be yours too. You hate that more than the threat. By the time the suite doors part, your face is clean again. Only the hand at your chest gives you away.
options.tonal_effect: Narration becomes sealed, withholding, and body-forward.

options.label: B
options.text: You file the warning away and treat it like useful threat data.
options.outcome: You do not believe her care. You do believe her information. That is enough. The word active stays with you for its operational shape, not its ache. If the system still sees you as a diver, then it still has routes into you. Access. Permissions. Old ghosts in clean channels. You carry that forward like a tool wrapped in cloth. Dangerous to touch bare-handed. Useful if you must. Ilya may mean mercy. She may mean containment. For now, the distinction can wait. The suite cannot.

npc_dispositions.shift: Perceived as analytically engaged rather than purely hostile.

options.world_noticed_signal: NO SIGNAL — state change is minor

options.label: C
options.text: You let the warning make you angrier and carry that heat into the suite.
options.outcome: Her concern lands wrong. Like a hand on a bruise. You take the anger because it is cleaner than the other thing trying to rise with it. The building still thinks it owns the old version of you. Good. Let it be surprised. By the time you cross the threshold, the heat has settled into your shoulders and your grip on the lens. Not wild. Worse. Directed. If the system remembers its divers, then it can remember this. The one who walked back in and did not kneel.
options.tonal_effect: Narration gains hotter defiance without losing control.

emotional_choices.source_moment: First sight of the three Mirror Agents across the plaza.
emotional_choices.narrative_lead_in: Across the plaza, the puddle moves first. Then the window. Then the door. Three faces turn toward you from the wrong side of the world.
emotional_choices.choice_question: What happens in your body before you run?

options.label: A
options.text: You let the fear hit full and turn it into speed.
options.outcome: The first shock is clean. Better than thought. Your lungs seize once, then open hard. The city tilts into exits and angles and wet concrete. No time for dignity. No time for analysis. Just motion before the geometry closes. The Agents read as wrong in pieces you cannot afford to name. A jawline too smooth. A step half a beat off. The fear gives you one gift. It strips the plaza to path. By the time the first one peels fully out of the puddle, you are already moving.
options.tonal_effect: Narration accelerates into kinetic fragments and stripped sensory triage.
options.world_noticed_signal: NO SIGNAL — state change is minor

options.label: B
options.text: You force yourself to count threats before you commit to the run.
options.outcome: One from the puddle. One from the window. One from the citadel doors. You count because counting keeps the body from breaking into noise. Three vectors. One open descent. Civilians mid-loop and useless as cover. The lens already in your hand. The fear does not leave. It gets sorted. Filed. Made to stand in rows while you pick the least bad line through them. When you run, it is because the math is done, not because the panic won.
options.tonal_effect: Narration becomes diagnostic and spatially precise.
options.world_noticed_signal: NO SIGNAL — state change is minor

options.label: C
options.text: You lock your breathing down and refuse to let them see a flinch.
options.outcome: In for four. Hold. Out. Old dive discipline. The body remembers even when the life around it does not. The Agents step out of glass into air and you give them nothing back but a still face and one hard look. Not bravado. Control. You are already hunted. There is no profit in helping them taste it. The fear goes to ground in your sternum and stays there while your legs take over. When you break into the run, it looks chosen. That matters to no one but you. It still matters.
options.tonal_effect: Narration cools into controlled bodily procedure under horror.

emotional_choices.source_moment: Alley aftermath as Nora studies the longer crack and glimpses the etched thread.
emotional_choices.narrative_lead_in: The alley has gone dark. Your lungs have not. In the longer fracture, light catches on something too precise to be damage.
emotional_choices.choice_question: How do you meet what Eli hid here?

options.label: A
options.text: You study the fracture like evidence and chase the pattern.
options.outcome: You turn the lens by millimeters. Rain. Thumb. Angle. Light. Gone. Back again. The thread is not decorative. Not random stress. Embedded. Deliberate. Your breathing slows because the work demands it, not because you are calm. Eli left you a problem with edges. Better than a ghost. Better than a promise. The alley around you stays dead and wet and full of chrome dust, but the object in your hand has changed species. Not keepsake now. Not only. Key. You tuck that away before the feeling under it can rise and complicate the clean fact of it.
options.tonal_effect: Narration sharpens into procedural wonder and evidentiary focus.

persistent_state_changes.inventory: Cracked Lens symbolic meaning shifts toward data key.

options.world_noticed_signal: The crack answers only one angle of light. Then goes blank again.

options.label: B
options.text: You steady your hands and test the fracture with patient care.
options.outcome: You handle it like damaged equipment first. Support at the rim. No pressure on the new vein. Rotate. Stop. Check the edge again. The care is almost clinical until the thread catches and you realize what that care was protecting. Something left for you. Not the whole of him. Not mercy. Work. The distinction matters enough to keep your hands steady. You do not solve it here. You do not force it. You learn the limits of the object and keep it intact long enough to matter later. Good. Necessary. Harder than smashing would have been.
options.tonal_effect: Narration leans careful, tactile, and preservation-minded.

persistent_state_changes.inventory: Cracked Lens symbolic meaning shifts toward fragile evidence object.

options.world_noticed_signal: Rain beads along the rim and does not cross the fracture.

options.label: C
options.text: You feel the discovery as a fresh wound before you let it become a clue.
options.outcome: The first hit is not intellectual. It is bodily. The object warms in your palm and for one bad second it feels like he touched back. No. Glass. Heat. Memory in procedure's clothing. You let the wrong feeling pass through without pretending it is data. Then you look again. Harder now. Cleaner. Whatever Eli buried here, he buried it in the one thing you never put down. That lands where words would not. By the time you thread the lens back under your coat, the ache has narrowed into purpose sharp enough to carry.
options.tonal_effect: Narration allows a brief bodily ache before snapping back to purpose.

persistent_state_changes.inventory: Cracked Lens symbolic meaning deepens as grief tether and clue.

npc_dispositions.shift: Potential emotional access +1 around Eli-linked objects.

options.world_noticed_signal: For a beat the glass feels warm. Then only wet.

emotional_choices.source_moment: Apartment light test when Nora realizes Eli embedded something analog in the lens.
emotional_choices.narrative_lead_in: Bad apartment light. Wet coat. Blood on your palm. The thread appears in the glass and vanishes when the angle shifts.
emotional_choices.choice_question: What do you let this mean before you start moving again?

options.label: A
options.text: You treat his hidden thread as a task he left you alive to finish.
options.outcome: You do not linger on the missing shape of him. You stay with the work. Eli embedded analog data in a cracked lens because he knew what the system could not read clean. Because he knew you would keep it. Because he trusted your hands more than any archive. That is enough meaning for now. Maybe all you can afford. The tenderness stays buried under the procedure of packing, but it changes the weight of every object that follows. Tools. Patch. Holocorder. Nutrient packs. None of them matter like the lens does. None of them were chosen by him for you.
options.tonal_effect: Narration keeps grief compressed under task logic and chosen responsibility.

persistent_state_changes.inventory: Cracked Lens symbolic meaning shifts toward mission object.

options.world_noticed_signal: The lens goes back to your sternum like a tool returning to its slot.

options.label: B
options.text: You let yourself feel that he knew exactly what you would keep carrying.
options.outcome: You stand there one second too long. Enough to understand the cruelty and the care of it. He hid it here. In the object already worn smooth by your thumb. In the thing pressed to your chest when everything else failed. Not a message anyone could mass-produce. Not a system gift. Personal. Deliberate. The room does not get a speech out of you. It gets a stillness. Then the stillness breaks. You pack faster after that. Not because the feeling is gone. Because it is not.
options.tonal_effect: Narration softens into restrained ache, then snaps back into motion.

persistent_state_changes.inventory: Cracked Lens symbolic meaning deepens as personal continuity object.

options.world_noticed_signal: The cord leaves a damp line across your palm before you hide it again.

options.label: C
options.text: You hold both truths at once: relic and evidence.
options.outcome: You do not force the object to choose what it is. It can be his. It can be proof. It can be the only clean route left through a dirty system. The balance steadies you more than comfort would have. Not because it hurts less. Because it asks for less lying. You pack around that fact. Everything else becomes support structure for the lens. The bag. The tools. The body carrying it. When the thread vanishes again in the bad light, you do not chase it. You already know enough. It is real. It is hidden. It is yours to take forward.
options.tonal_effect: Narration balances tenderness with operational clarity.

persistent_state_changes.inventory: Cracked Lens symbolic meaning expands: relic plus evidence plus key.

options.world_noticed_signal: The light slips off the crack. The certainty does not.

options.label: A

options.label: B

options.label: A

options.label: B

options.label: A

options.label: B

options.label: A
options.text: You scan every reflection for the next breach.
options.narration_adjustment: Puddle. Window. Door glass. You read the city as a field of mouths. It is slower than panic and faster than trust.

options.label: B
options.text: You ignore the surfaces and choose the exit.
options.narration_adjustment: Looking too hard is how they keep you. You pick a line through stairs and railings and let the rest of the horror stay peripheral.

posture_shifts.placement: mid Escalation. Under pursuit pressure in the descent. Dry refusal, silence, or blunt accusation energy.
posture_shifts.narrator_line: The run leaves no room for speeches, only the shape of one.

options.label: A
options.text: You keep your mouth shut and spend breath on speed.

options.label: B

posture_shifts.placement: during Breath beat. Alley aftermath. Handle the lens as evidence, relic, or wound.

options.label: A
options.text: You hold it up like evidence.
options.narration_adjustment: Thumb at the rim. Eye on the fracture. If it hurts, it can wait. First it has to tell you what it is.

options.label: B
options.text: You press it to your sternum before hiding it.
options.narration_adjustment: The gesture is quick. Nearly nothing. Still enough to change the air around the object before it disappears under the coat again.

options.label: C
options.text: You grip it like the thing that cut you.
options.narration_adjustment: Blood slicks the cord. The crack has cost now. You do not sentimentalize what bites back.

posture_shifts.placement: late Twist. Jace's first tether contact and the involuntary bleed. Resentment even while needing it.

options.label: A

options.label: B

options.label: C

options.narration_adjustment: Voice. Route. Signal quality. Symptom load. You turn the impossible into categories because categories can be carried.

session_close_design.resolution_prose:
You go with Jace into the dark as the concourse empties behind you. Blue-white light dies section by section. One strip at a time. Clean. Final. The first decode is yours now. Not promised. Not theoretical. Chosen.

The lens sits hot against your sternum. The tether hum answers from somewhere just left of your pulse. Not comfort. Not pain. A live channel. Real.

Ahead, the service tunnel sweats rust and old water. Jace keeps pace without touching you. Close enough to count as cover. Far enough to leave you room. Behind you, Site Three seals itself with a hydraulic groan and a last wash of amber through the dust.

You have what you came for. The warning was real. Riven was real. The cost is real too. Thirty-four hours on the countdown. Five percent port integrity. A first decode waiting inside cracked glass Eli left in your hand.

You keep walking.

Still here.

Countdown, survivor, relay board, and residue-in-port pressure explain the scene without lore speech. Core-stakes proximity: Very high. This is the session's central question in the room already: truth pursuit versus bodily survival, and Eli's trace versus continuity.

Active world rules: Nora's corrupted port is both the way into Eli's lens and the thing exposing them to the Mirror; using it costs integrity. Stake: if she waits, time burns and people stay trapped. If she decodes, she may destroy the last channel carrying what Eli left behind and lose her own continuity with it.
